content.comment_body: Are the outputs of [product_name] Analog Output Module [product_name] isolated? Is it possible to generate a bi-polar +/-10V output signal by combining two outputs from this module? Thank you!

Hello, The outputs are not isolated. It is not possible to create a bipolar output using two unipolar (0-10V) outputs in this manner. To achieve this, you would need a dedicated signal converter. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked if the outputs on the [product_name] analog output module are isolated and whether combining them would allow the creation of a bi-polar voltage output. Response clarified that the outputs are not isolated and combining two unipolar outputs does not produce a bipolar signal, emphasizing that this module does not support such functionality without additional equipment.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipated the analog output module to feature isolated outputs and to allow for output combination to create a bi-polar voltage signal.
